description: This file defines an abstract class `PadNode` which extends `PcbNode`. It encapsulates properties related to a pad's position (`PointNode at`), size (`SizeNode size`), and name, providing parsing logic for pad shape types like rect, circle, and oval, and methods to check if a point is connected to the pad.

classes.name: PadNode
classes.description: An abstract representation of a PCB pad element that includes position and size details.

methods.name: PadNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing name, position, size, and children elements of the pad node.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given point is connected to this pad based on its position and size.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Factory method to create specific pad node instances (`RectPadNode`, `CirclePadNode`) based on shape type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the pad node for debugging.
